title: Drainage Myth vs Fact: Chemical Cleaners and Pipes
description: Many property owners assume that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down slow drains is a safe and effective maintenance shortcut. In reality, caustic chemical products can generate extreme heat, potentially warping plastic drainage piping or damaging older metallic systems, while failing to clear the root cause of stubborn clogs. Professional plumbers know that mechanical clearing methods, such as augering or proper hydro-scouring, protect the integrity of the drainage network. Understanding how different materials react to harsh substances prevents costly property damage and ensures long-term system reliability.
caption:
Drainage Myth vs Fact: Chemical Cleaners and Pipes

Many property owners assume that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down slow drains is a safe and effective maintenance shortcut. In reality, caustic chemical products can generate extreme heat, potentially warping plastic drainage piping or damaging older metallic systems, while failing to clear the root cause of stubborn clogs. Professional plumbers know that mechanical clearing methods, such as augering or proper hydro-scouring, protect the integrity of the drainage network. Understanding how different materials react to harsh substances prevents costly property damage and ensures long-term system reliability.
